name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
summary: Mumbai steel processing centre that slits and cuts coated steel coils for appliance, HVAC and auto makers; JSW Steel authorised partner since 2021.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,267 Cr (+20%), PAT ₹30.5 Cr (+6%, 2.4% margin); debt/equity 2.8x.
positives: 100% fresh issue; ₹125 Cr goes to debt repayment
red_flags: Thin margins (PAT 2.4%); finance cost eats most of EBIT
Dependence on JSW Steel; capacity only ~60% used
anchor: ₹54.1 Cr from 6 small AIFs/funds (IMAP Catalyst ₹20 Cr, LRSD ₹14 Cr); no MFs or insurers
